# Thinking Cube

> Thinking Cube is an open-source React component (npm package `thinking-cube`) that renders animated wireframe-cube loading indicators for AI interfaces. Nine hand-tuned states show what an AI agent is doing (searching, solving, planning, listening, writing and more) instead of a generic spinner. One 2D canvas, zero runtime dependencies, about 7 kB gzipped, MIT licensed. Made by Sanskar Shukla, inspired by thinking-orbs.

Install with `npm i thinking-cube`, then render `<ThinkingCube state="searching" size={64} />`. It works with React 18 and 19, Next.js (ships with "use client"), Vite and Remix. TypeScript types are included.

States: `working`, `searching`, `solving`, `listening`, `connecting`, `weaving` (planning), `composing` (writing), `breathing` (thinking), `shaping`.

Props: `state`, `size` (CSS px, tuned for 64 and 20), `speed`, `dark`, `theme` ('auto' | 'dark' | 'light'), `paused`.

## Docs

- [Full documentation for LLMs](https://cube.sanskarshukla.com/llms-full.txt): states, props, recipes, accessibility, in one plain-text file
- [Live demo and playground](https://cube.sanskarshukla.com/): every state running, with a props playground
- [README on GitHub](https://github.com/sanskar0627/thinking-cube#readme): quick start, states table, API
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/thinking-cube): install and version info
